title: Late Window Radio · Hero in Motion example
headline: Still up? So are we.
summary: Late Window Radio: slow records and quiet talk from a one-room studio, every night from eleven until the first trains.
poster_alt: A city at night. In one lit window a radio host in headphones sits at a microphone under a red on-air lamp, and a rooftop mast sends out rings of signal. A still illustration.
details: Late Window Radio is a made-up brand for this example. It shows the cover layout: the picture fills the hero, the words sit on top of it, and focus keeps the lit window in view on a narrow screen.
